# -- eotg_test_harness.txt ------------------------------------------------------
# GENERATED by docs/tools/gen_test_harness.py: never hand-edit; change the generator and re-run.
# In-game test harness: the delayed assertions (docs/qa/TEST_HARNESS.md).
# Every event here is HIDDEN and fired ONLY by an eotg_decision_test_*
# decision (common/decisions/eotg_test_harness_decisions.txt), which are
# debug_only (invariant 4: always fired by something; no on_action hook).
# Root = the decision taker. Scopes saved by the decision (eotg_test_county,
# eotg_test_target, eotg_test_subject, actor, recipient) carry into the delayed
# event, as the mod's own chains rely on (e.g. eotg_aug_heir.006 reads
# scope:eotg_heir days later).
# Assertions read the systems' own scripted triggers and values only.
# UNVERIFIED-VANILLA: debug_log writes its literal string to game.log (the
#   effect is used in v2 script, eotg_race_effects.txt, with data functions;
#   the strings here are plain text on purpose).
# UNVALIDATED cloud build.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

namespace = eotg_test

eotg_test.101 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_is_aug_tier1 = yes
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY1.1 PASS: Augmented (tier 1)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY1.1 FAIL: not tier 1 after eotg_aug_initiate_effect"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                prowess >= { value = var:eotg_test_prowess_base add = 2 }
                prowess <= { value = var:eotg_test_prowess_base add = 2 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY1.2 PASS: prowess +2 at Augmented"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY1.2 FAIL: prowess is not base +2 at Augmented"
        }
        eotg_aug_set_integration_effect = { XP = 50 }
        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.102  days = 1 }
    }
}

}

eotg_test.151 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_trait = wounded_3
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY6.1 PASS: wound rank 3 reached"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY6.1 FAIL: three increase_wounds_effect calls did not reach wounded_3 (a death roll or an existing wound may interfere)"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:eotg_aug_repair_injury ?= flag:wounded
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY6.2 PASS: on_trait_gained fired for wounded_3: the repair is queued"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY6.2 FAIL: no repair queued: change_trait_rank does not fire on_trait_gained for wounded_3 (PROC §4.9 engine question)"
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY6 LOOK: eotg_aug_proc.003 should arrive within 30 days"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY6 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.201 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = {
                    eotg_frontier_is_frontier = yes
                    var:eotg_frontier_type ?= flag:military
                }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a.1 PASS: the capital is a military Frontier"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a.1 FAIL: the capital is not a Frontier of that type (was it Abandoned and not resettlable?)"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = { eotg_frontier_has_valid_founder = yes }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a.2 PASS: you are its valid founder"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a.2 FAIL: no valid founder recorded"
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a LOOK: the Shoal shows Frontier: Outpost; (Debug) Frontier Readout gives progress and strain"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.211 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = eotg_frontier_state }
                }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2.1 PASS: the Frontier completed and cleared (normal play takes over)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2.1 FAIL: still a Frontier: the development or control floor was not met; run FR2 again, or see the Readout"
        }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:eotg_test_county = { var:eotg_test_type ?= flag:military } }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2 LOOK: E-12 / SI V8: hover the new Bastion barony, note who holds it and whether a stray character was created"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:eotg_test_county = { var:eotg_test_type ?= flag:religious } }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2 LOOK: FX-2: note the new Sanctum holder gender (expected male under a male-only clergy); G-2: note their government and the vassal contract"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2 LOOK: E-4: which holding appeared and who holds it (never the founder unless they rule); G-2: the Local Ruler government and contract"
        }
        scope:eotg_test_county = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = eotg_test_type }
                remove_variable = eotg_test_type
            }
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.221 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = { var:eotg_frontier_progress <= 100 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR3.1 PASS: progress 98 + 4 is clamped at 100"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR3.1 FAIL: progress went above 100"
        }
        scope:eotg_test_county = {
            set_variable = { name = eotg_frontier_strain  value = 8 }
            eotg_frontier_add_strain_effect = { CAUSE = hardship }
        }
        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.222  days = 1 }
    }
}

eotg_test.222 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = { var:eotg_frontier_strain <= 8 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR3.2 PASS: strain 8 + 1 is clamped at 8"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR3.2 FAIL: strain went above 8"
        }
        scope:eotg_test_county = {
            set_variable = { name = eotg_frontier_strain  value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = eotg_frontier_progress  value = 1 }
            eotg_frontier_add_progress_effect = { AMOUNT = -3 }
        }
        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.223  days = 1 }
    }
}

eotg_test.223 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = { var:eotg_frontier_progress >= 0 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR3.3 PASS: progress 1 - 3 is clamped at 0"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR3.3 FAIL: progress went below 0"
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR3 DONE (strain reset to 0; progress left at 0)"
    }
}

eotg_test.301 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_target = { has_subject_contract_group = eotg_cartel_tributary }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.1 PASS: the neighbour is a payer in eotg_cartel_tributary"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.1 FAIL: the neighbour is not in the Cartel contract group"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_cartel_payer_count_value >= 1
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.2 PASS: the payer count sees the new payer"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.2 FAIL: eotg_cartel_payer_count_value is 0"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = eotg_cartel_schedule_scale
                var:eotg_cartel_schedule_scale >= 4
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.3 PASS: the dread baseline mirror rose (4 per payer)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.3 FAIL: eotg_cartel_schedule_scale did not rise"
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1 LOOK: the character window shows +4 Dread baseline per payer; the Payment Schedule story counter matches your dread"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.311 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_cartel_payer_count_value < var:eotg_test_payers_before
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2.1 PASS: one payer walked off"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2.1 FAIL: the payer count did not fall"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_cartel_payer_count_value >= { value = var:eotg_test_payers_before add = -1 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2.2 PASS: no more than one payer left"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2.2 FAIL: more than one payer left in a single walk-off"
        }
        remove_variable = eotg_test_payers_before
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2 LOOK: the A Payer Walks toast named the payer; the baseline modifier dropped by 4"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.431 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_implant_calibrated }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST AL4.1 PASS: calibration has lapsed"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST AL4.1 FAIL: the calibration modifier is still present"
        }
        if = {
            limit = { can_execute_decision = eotg_decision_maintenance_protocol }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST AL4 LOOK: Maintenance Protocol can be taken, so the top bar should show the calibration alert"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST AL4 LOOK: Maintenance Protocol cannot be taken now (cost or cooldown), so the alert is correctly hidden"
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST AL4 DONE"
    }
}
